mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a new home construction project in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for new home construction varies based on design complexity, size, and local permitting processes. Generally, a custom home can take anywhere from 10 to 18 months from groundbreaking to move-in. This includes phases like foundation work, framing, roofing, utility installations, interior finishes, and final inspections. Factors such as weather delays, material availability, and client-requested changes can also influence the overall schedule. We provide a detailed project schedule at the outset to manage expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: New home construction in Pasadena typically takes 10 to 18 months, depending on complexity and permitting. This includes all phases from foundation to final inspections.
